system.description:
No mortal mind can resist your will. With a touch you pour your consciousness into a living body, suppressing its mind and taking full control while your own form lies comatose.

Touch a mortal subject (a Physical Challenge may be needed for a firm grip), spend a Willpower Trait, and make a Mental Challenge (retest Intimidation). On a win you seize the body as your own collapses; spend a Mental Trait to complete the possession, with additional Mental Traits allowing use of some Disciplines per the table. You experience and suffer all that happens to the host, and if it dies before you flee you fall into torpor. To leave, announce your intent at the start of a turn; your spirit departs at its end. Ineffective against vampires and other supernatural creatures.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
